title: 第1445章 东窗事发第1444章 还好我聪明
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
当画面逐渐变得清晰的时候，黄远的表情直接愣住了。
这跟他预设的根本不一样！
在反抗军的大营中，众人都离去了，只有他跟青灵相互对峙的画面。
“你这个天道的走狗，人类的叛徒蛀虫，还有什么颜面活在这个世界上！”
“呵呵…真是一群蠢货，我只需要略施小计就把你们耍的团团转，玄华那个贱人，马上就要成为天道的美食了！”
“而我，必将踩着你们攀上巅峰！”
画面之中，黄远的表情愈发嚣张，充满了小人得志的神态。
与之相对的，众人的脸色顿时变得铁青。
画面中的声音还在继续。
“当狗都当上瘾了，你没有尊严吗！”
“尊严？哈哈…这是近百年来我听到的最好笑的笑话，尊严能值几个钱，能让我拥有这无可匹敌的力量吗！”
“能给天道当狗是我的荣幸，而你们，可以作为养料补全天道，更是祖上积德，几辈子攒来的福分，你们要懂得感恩！”
“你不得好死！”
“真有意思，反正也是你先死！”
下一刻，只见其手握法则光团，按在了青灵的胸口上。
接下来的事情被真实的展现了出来，青灵气绝，身上的黑暗本源被黑瓶吸走，一切都在电光火石之间发生。
“黄远！！！”
玄华睚眦欲裂，眼神中迸发出来的几乎噬人的怒火，她现在心中有一万个念头，每个念头都在想着如何将眼前这个家伙碎尸万段！
万万没想到，最大的隐患，竟然潜藏在自己的眼底下。
所谓灯下黑，还真是黑的令人发颤啊！

“等等…这是栽赃这是陷害，这全部都是假的！”
黄远连忙摆手，脚步踉跄，脸色变得无比苍白。
“你们好好的想一想，这绝对是有人在陷害我，别忘了我们提取的可是这小子的记忆，又怎么可能出现这种画面？”
此话一出，有几人神色一愣，渐渐的冷静了下来。
此话在理啊，这些画面不应该出现在周通的记忆中。
“首领，看来此事真的有猫腻，有人要挑拨我们与副首领之间的关系，绝对不能上当啊！”
“说的没错，这画面是假的，莫非这小子真是罪魁祸首，是他用了诡异的手段？”
一时间，所有怀疑的目光再次聚焦到了周通的身上。
“哼，略施小计而已…”
黄远嘴角上扬，再一次得意忘形。
“老圣王，你去看一看青灵的状况！”
这一次，玄华没有冲动，继而对周通发难。
画面之中，青灵逝去的那一幕给她带来了极大的冲击，愤怒混合着悲伤，因为过于强烈，反倒让她冷静了下来。
“是！”
须臾，老圣王去而复返，脸上带着悲戚之色。
“青灵领队她…已经，已经去了！”
“呃！！”
玄华浑身剧烈的颤抖，一滴眼泪从明眸中滑落，还会顺着脸颊滴下，就被一股气场蒸干！
“你不是说，她还活着吗！”
汹涌的杀气奔腾而出，朝着黄远镇压了过去。
content_en:
When the picture gradually became clear, Huang Yuan's expression was stunned.
This is completely different from what he expected!
In the resistance camp, everyone left, leaving only the scene of him and Qing Ling confronting each other.
"You, a lackey of heaven and a traitor to mankind, how can you still have the dignity to live in this world!"
"Haha... What a bunch of idiots. I only need to use a little trick to trick you all around. That bitch Xuanhua will soon become the delicacy of heaven!"
"And I will definitely step on you to reach the top!"
In the picture, Huang Yuan's expression becomes more and more arrogant, full of the demeanor of a villain who has succeeded.
In contrast, everyone's faces suddenly turned livid.
The sound on the screen continues.
"Being a dog is like an addiction. Don't you have any dignity?"
"Dignity? Haha... This is the funniest joke I have heard in the past hundred years. How much is dignity worth? Can it allow me to have this unrivaled power!"
"It is my honor to be a dog for Heaven, and you can be used as nourishment to complete Heaven's Dao. It is also a blessing accumulated by ancestors over several lifetimes. You must know how to be grateful!"
"You have to die!"
"How interesting, you will die first anyway!"
The next moment, I saw him holding the law light group and pressing it on Qing Ling's chest.
The next thing was truly revealed. Qing Ling was completely exhausted, and the dark origin of his body was sucked away by the black bottle. Everything happened in a flash of lightning.
"Huang Yuan!!!"
Xuanhua's eyes were about to split, and the almost consuming anger burst out from her eyes. She now had ten thousand thoughts in her mind, and every thought was thinking about how to cut the guy in front of her into pieces!
He never expected that the biggest hidden danger was lurking right under his eyes.
The so-called darkness under the lamp is really so dark that it makes people tremble!
"Wait a minute...this is frame-up, this is frame-up, this is all false!"
Huang Yuan waved his hands quickly, staggering, and his face became extremely pale.
"Think about it carefully. Someone is definitely framing me. Don't forget that what we extracted is this kid's memory. How could such a scene appear?"
As soon as these words came out, several people looked stunned and gradually calmed down.
This makes sense. These scenes should not appear in Zhou Tong's memory.
"Chief, it seems there is something really fishy about this matter. Someone wants to sow discord between us and the deputy leader. We must not be fooled!"
"That's right. This picture is fake. Could it be that this kid is really the culprit? Did he use weird means?"
For a moment, all suspicious eyes focused on Zhou Tong again.
"Huh, just a little trick..."
The corners of Huang Yuan's mouth rose, and he got carried away once again.
"Old Holy King, go and take a look at Qing Ling's condition!"
This time, Xuanhua was not impulsive and attacked Zhou Tong.
In the picture, the scene of Qing Ling's death had a great impact on her. The anger was mixed with sadness. Because it was too strong, it actually made her calm down.
"Yes!"
After a while, the old holy king left and came back again, with a look of sadness on his face.
"Leader Qing Ling...has already left!"
"Ugh!!"
Xuanhua's whole body trembled violently, a tear slipped from his bright eyes, and dripped down his cheek, before being evaporated by the aura!
"Didn't you say that she is still alive?"
The surging murderous intent rushed out and suppressed Huang Yuan.
